Dr. Mohal Banker is a board-certified Interventional Radiologist who has been practicing in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India since 2001. Before this, he received a Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery from M. P. Shah Medical College in Jamnagar in 1997. Dr. Banker received his radiology training at Guru Gobind Singh Hospital in Jamnagar in 2000. Dr. Banker received Vascular Malformation treatment training from Dr. Wayne Yakes in USA. Dr Banker is specialized in pain treatment of Different Joints of body like knee and Shoulder.
